# Puck 2.0.0-alpha.3 Rust preview

Rust owns processing; the synchronous typed ESM facade embeds WASM. Native
consumers use C ABI 1. Install @clankagent/puck@2.0.0-alpha.3
on npm's next channel, also available as a tarball from the matching GitHub
prerelease. Stable npm latest remains 1.0.0.
Read docs/native.md, docs/rust-verification.md and docs/upgrading.md first.
The current WASM bridge adds browser processing and startup cost.

This preview fixes deterministic topological precedence, native numeric
spelling equivalence, no-op restoration of numerically identical settings,
construction-time eventLimit retention and malformed gesture/reset validation.
Installation entry points, public API, C ABI 1 and hardware scope are unchanged.
Read CHANGELOG.md and docs/upgrading.md. These fixes are absent from alpha.2.

The 1.0.0 npm package does not include button events. Use the 1.1.0 source or
a later preview for the button API.

> TypeScript/ESM SDK for SpaceMouse continuous controls, discrete commands and persistent interactions. Zero runtime dependencies.

Start with README.md, docs/quickstart.md and docs/application-api.md. Import only
@clankagent/puck, @clankagent/puck/webhid and @clankagent/puck/graph. Exact types
are dist/index.d.ts, dist/webhid.d.ts and dist/graph.d.ts.

- Application API: docs/application-api.md
- Upgrade from 0.x and development previews: docs/upgrading.md
- Changelog: CHANGELOG.md
- Physical/software validation and limitations: docs/v1-verification.md
- Motion and supported hardware: docs/motion.md
- SpaceMouse Wireless button events: docs/buttons.md
- Gesture tunes/calibration: docs/tuning.md
- Low-level compatibility reference: docs/api.md
- Tilt and press/rotate: docs/press-tilt.md, docs/press-rotate.md
- Integration invariants: docs/agents.md
- Troubleshooting: docs/troubleshooting.md
- Playground/debug: docs/playground.md
- Gesture lab: docs/lab.md
- Roadmap: docs/roadmap.md
- Contributions: CONTRIBUTING.md, AGENTS.md
- Releases: RELEASING.md

Core owns no DOM, timers or storage. connectPuck owns transport/lifecycle/deadlines;
applications own rendering, cameras and persistence. Raw input is normalized sensor
deflection. Semantic tilt is [-ry,rx], right/down positive. Gesture calibration is
not continuous-motion calibration. Hardware scope: 256f:c63a Bluetooth on Windows.

Demo: https://clankagent.github.io/puck/
Tester: https://clankagent.github.io/puck/#tester
Debug: https://clankagent.github.io/puck/#debug
